Name: HearthTunes
Author: NautilusStardew
Description:
[b]What it does[/b]

HearthTunes lets you add your own music to Stardew Valley’s jukebox system.
• Loads custom music files from the Music folder inside the mod directory
• Automatically registers tracks into the jukebox list
• Plays alongside vanilla music through the existing jukebox interface
• Designed for simple drag-and-drop personal music libraries

Drop your songs into the Music folder, launch the game, and they will appear in the jukebox!

[b]Audio format requirements (important)[/b]

This mod requires Vorbis .ogg audio files.

Other `.ogg encodings (such as Opus) will not play correctly.

A reliable and free tool for conversion is Audacity, which can export audio directly to Vorbis .ogg.

[b]If converting from other online sources, a mega-popular video streaming website for example, Google searching for ways to convert that website’s audio into Vorbis OGG format will certainly provide useful tools. Enough said. [/b]

[b][u][size=4]Some conversion tools will give you .oga files. Simply rename the files to .ogg for the game to recognize them. [/size][/u][/b]

[b]Compatibility notes[/b]

• Better Jukebox is not a required dependency, but is strongly recommended
• Each track added by HearthTunes will appear in the jukebox list with the prefix:
• HearthTunes_
• This prefix is intentional and helps keep tracks grouped together in alphabetical lists, especially when using mods like Better Jukebox
• Unlike some custom music mods, HearthTunes intentionally does not replace or interfere with world music cues or ambient soundtrack systems
• It is limited to jukebox playback only, like a personal record collection

[b]Library size[/b]

• There is a theoretical limit to how large the music library can be, but it has not been reached or properly stress tested
• My personal test library currently contains 13 tracks
• A larger library should be fine in theory, but real-world limits are unknown at this time. I think it should be able to handle 20-30 songs without issue, possibly much more. If you find the limit, let me know!

[b]Design philosophy[/b]

This mod was built for my own farm playthrough as a way to turn areas within my farm into a personal listening space. It is intentionally minimal and focused only on getting custom music into the jukebox cleanly.

[b]Important notes[/b]

• This is a personal-use release
• It is provided as-is
• I am not planning to actively maintain or provide support
• Compatibility with other mods may vary
• Future game updates may break functionality
• You are free to fork or modify it for your own use!
